note: Initial JavaScript per route, gzip KB of the entry chunk plus the route's page chunks and their static imports (scripts/ci/route-js-budget.mjs). A route fails when it grows more than `tolerance` over its baseline or exceeds `cap_kb`. Lower a baseline with --write when a route shrinks; raising one needs a stated reason in the PR. `never_initial` names heavy lazy vendor chunks (maps: Leaflet/deck.gl, three, charts) that no measured route may load before first paint.
